title: 第一卷 第10章 是非对错，老子看不出嘛？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

叶老村长眯着眼睛，看向被人搀扶着，脸色涨红的叶龙，心里边明白得很，冷声道，“叶龙，是非对错，你心里明白，别人也看得清楚。我现在就问你，错了没？”

叶龙呼吸急促，一来是因为胸口实在是太疼了。

再者，这里明明是上叶村，是自己的地盘，为什么自己还会被闫耀宗压着？

叶龙不服。

可再不服，他也不敢胡说八道了。

“村长，我、我错了！”叶龙咬着牙道。

听到叶龙认错，叶老村长扭头看向闫耀宗，道：“耀宗，叶龙认错了，这事儿，能翻篇不？”

闫耀宗半眯着眼睛，直勾勾地盯着呼呼呼喘着粗气的叶龙，平静地说道，“老村长，既然叶龙认错，那我也不是斤斤计较的人，这事儿，可以翻篇。但，有些话，我要讲明白！”

“你讲！”

“昨天在溪山的事情，我没想过计较什么。但，今儿个的事情，叶龙还要给我一个交代！”

“闫耀宗，我都认怂了，你还想要怎么样？”叶龙怒视着闫耀宗。

叶老村长也挑了挑眉，道：“耀宗，你继续讲。我还是那句话，是非对错，我看得明白。”

闫耀宗深吸一口气，目露精光，道：“老村长，这场暴雨，持续了一个多月，咱们几个村的存粮，都快吃完了。为了一口吃食，我跟振东冒险去镇里。老村长，你知不知道，黄家庄已经被淹了？”

闫耀宗紧握着拳头，呼吸也急促了起来，“短短三十来里路，我跟振东走了六个多小时，稍有不慎，就会被洪流冲走。”

“我们冒着生命危险，去镇里见了镇长，求了各种药物……”

“老村长，你可以说，我们去镇里，是为了自己。但，论迹不论心，我们确确实实把药送来了！”

“而叶龙跟他爹，一见面，根本不听我们解释，上来就要揍我们！”

“说不心寒，肯定是假的！”

“你们可以不认这个恩情，但，你们也不能对我们棍棒相向啊！”

闫耀宗没想过施恩图报。

他要上叶村的人

听完闫耀宗的话，老村长深吸一口气，道：“耀宗，你这话，有理。这事儿，确实是金宝跟叶龙做得不对！”

说到这里，老村长看向被叶建国搀扶着的叶龙，咬牙道，“叶龙，咱们上叶村虽然不是什么名门望族。但也是有规矩的。”

“来人，打断叶龙一条腿！”

众人面面相觑。

见没人动手，老村长脸色越加难看，“我现在讲的话，没用了嘛？既然如此，老子自己来！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Village Chief Ye squinted his eyes and looked at Ye Long, who was being supported by someone and his face turned red. He understood very well in his heart and said coldly, "Ye Long, you know right and wrong, and others can see it clearly. I'm going to ask you now, are you wrong?"

Ye Long was breathing rapidly, firstly because his chest hurt too much.

Furthermore, this is obviously Shangye Village and is his own territory. Why is he still being oppressed by Yan Yaozong?

Ye Long refused to accept it.

But no matter how dissatisfied he was, he didn't dare to talk nonsense.

"Village chief, I, I was wrong!" Ye Long said through gritted teeth.

Hearing that Ye Long admitted his mistake, Village Chief Ye turned to look at Yan Yaozong and said, "Yao Zong, Ye Long admitted his mistake. Can you change the story?"

Yan Yaozong half-squinted his eyes, staring directly at Ye Long, who was breathing heavily, and said calmly, "Old village chief, since Ye Long admits his mistake, I am not a person who cares about it. This matter can be changed. But, there are some things I want to make clear!"

"You tell me!"

"I never thought about what happened in Xishan yesterday. However, Ye Long still has to give me an explanation for what happened today!"

"Yan Yaozong, I've given up, what else do you want?" Ye Long glared at Yan Yaozong.

Village Chief Ye also raised his eyebrows and said: "Yao Zong, continue talking. I still say what I said, I can see clearly what is right and wrong."

Yan Yaozong took a deep breath, his eyes bright, and said: "Old village chief, this heavy rain has lasted for more than a month, and the grain reserves in several of our villages have almost been exhausted. In order to have a bite of food, Zhendong and I ventured to the town. Old village chief, do you know that Huangjiazhuang has been flooded?"

Yan Yaozong clenched his fists and breathed rapidly, "In just thirty miles, Zhendong and I walked for more than six hours. If we are not careful, we will be swept away by the torrent."

"We risked our lives and went to the town to see the mayor and asked for various medicines..."

"Old village chief, you can say that we went to the town for our own sake. But regardless of deeds, we did deliver the medicine!"

"As for Ye Long and his father, when they met, they didn't listen to our explanation at all, and they would beat us up!"

"If you say you're not feeling chilling, you'd definitely be lying!"

"You can deny this kindness, but you can't use sticks against us either!"

Yan Yaozong never thought about repaying his kindness.

He wants to go to Yecun people

After listening to Yan Yaozong's words, the old village chief took a deep breath and said, "Yao Zong, what you say makes sense. It is indeed Jin Bao and Ye Long who did something wrong in this matter!"

Having said this, the old village chief looked at Ye Long, who was being supported by Ye Jianguo, and gritted his teeth and said, "Ye Long, although we are not a famous family in Shangye Village, we still have rules."

"Come here, break one of Ye Long's legs!"

Everyone looked at each other.

Seeing that no one took action, the old village chief's face became even more ugly, "What I'm saying now is useless? In that case, I'll do it myself!"
